title.narrative: Programme to Support the Health System Strengthening of The Bahamas

description.narrative: The Programme is designed to strengthen the primary care services in the Bahamas. The interventions consist of investing in modernizing the clinical and managerial capacity of the services, reinforcing the health infrastructure with climate resistant design and energy efficiency standards, procuring medical equipment, and accelerating the introduction of digital technology for the modernization of the health information system.
